entities.summary: GJ 3470 b is an exoplanet orbiting the star GJ 3470, located in the constellation Cancer. With a mass of just under 14 Earth-masses, a radius approximately 4.3 times that of Earth's, and a high equilibrium temperature of 615 K, it is a hot Neptune. Phailinsiam is a exoplanet. Classified as Tier E (Oral Tradition) evidence. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
